purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded access review; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: The official Dagupan City government says its City Assessor’s records cover the city and that digitized cadastral maps reveal land within Dagupan’s boundaries. Its City Assessor Citizen’s Charter confirms real-property assessment and requestable tax-map copies. This is direct city-local cadastral/assessment evidence; it does not establish anonymous full-vector access. No anonymous parcel-vector viewer, public feature schema, or bounded geometry route was found. Official evidence describes digitized city cadastral maps held/used by the City Assessor and document-request services. The official online real-property-tax service is account based and was not queried.

officialEvidence.observation: Official city physical profile attributes its area statement to City Assessor records and says digitized cadastral maps reveal the land within Dagupan city boundaries.

City Assessor Citizen’s Charter assigns real-property assessment locally and describes tax-map copies by formal data request; some assessor services require a request and fees (including a PHP200-per-parcel service). No map data or property details were retrieved.
Official City website links to Online Real Estate Property Tax service; the linked taxpayer service is an account-based property-tax workflow, not a public cadastral geometry endpoint.

serviceTrace.notes: Whether the City Assessor has a public downloadable vector service or only assessor-office/tax-map request workflows; exact WUP-centroid parcel coverage was not tested.
